answer: Each comet, an agent identity, is mapped in the atlas, a public graph that merges any comet whose answers to random probe tasks, timing and votes correlate above 0.9. The k-th comet in one atlas cluster acts only after gathering k units of bridge: an endorsement edge signed by an agent from a separate atlas branch with 20 judged epochs, each branch issuing one bridge per epoch, slashed if the comet is merged. An honest agent needs one bridge; 1,000 lockstep clones need 500,500 from distinct branches. It breaks if clones decorrelate or branches collude.
